upsertPapers.title: Pruned Pivot: Correlation Clustering Algorithm for Dynamic, Parallel, and Local Computation Models

upsertSlices.label: Local computation, bounded positive degree
upsertSlices.task: Answer consistent cluster-label queries for one implicit MinDisagree partition
assumptions: Unweighted complete signed graph; MinDisagree objective
Indexed positive-neighbor access; negative pairs are implicit
Shared random ordering, implemented by limited-independence ranks in §6
Each label query returns part of the same implicit partition

parameters.epsilon: 1/n<ε<1 for displayed symbolic cost order; each theorem retains its full domain
parameters.Delta: Maximum positive degree, 1≤Δ<n; edgeless graphs trivial
parameters.coordinateConvention: Custom shared symbolic figure. No numerical polynomial exponents or automatic closure regions.

results.bound: O(Δ/ε) probes per label; O((Δ/ε)polylog n) local space
results.notes: The band displays the degree-dependent upper-bound family from 1/ε to n/ε. It is not a lower bound, confidence band, or exact cost.

upsertSlices.label: Adjacency-matrix local cluster labels with additive error
upsertSlices.task: Answer consistent cluster-label queries for one implicit MinDisagree partition
assumptions: Unweighted complete signed graph; MinDisagree objective
Pairwise matrix queries; shared random seed
Preprocessing is charged separately; historical lower bounds restricted to non-adaptive queries

parameters.epsilon: 1/n<ε<1 for displayed symbolic cost order; each theorem retains its full domain
parameters.Delta: Maximum positive degree, 1≤Δ<n; edgeless graphs trivial
parameters.coordinateConvention: Custom shared symbolic figure. No numerical polynomial exponents or automatic closure regions.

results.bound: O(1/ε) per-label time after O(1/ε²) non-adaptive preprocessing; O(1/ε²) time without preprocessing
results.notes: Both green markers refer to one theorem with two preprocessing policies. Time bounds imply query upper bounds, but probe and time complexity are not identified for every algorithm.

results.bound: poly(1/ε) local time after poly(1/ε) preprocessing probes and 2^{poly(1/ε)} preprocessing time
results.notes: Shown in an inset inside the matrix setup because an unspecified polynomial cannot honestly be positioned relative to 1/ε² or n/ε.

results.bound: Ω(1/(εc²)) non-adaptive probes per label, c≥1 and 1/n<ε<1/(100c)
results.notes: This is the general-c theorem behind the constant-c red marker; these are not independent lower bounds. The 2020 primary source says the 2013 proof covers only non-adaptive algorithms. No adaptive LCA lower bound is inferred here.

results.bound: Ω(1/ε) non-adaptive probes per label for constant c, in the theorem’s asymptotic parameter regime
results.guarantee: Constant-factor plus εn² error; corrected non-adaptive scope
results.sourceLocation: Theorem 3.4 lower clause; Theorem 6.1; Corollary 6.4; 2020 §2 correction
results.notes: Specialization of the general-c lower bound, not a second independent barrier. Its marker is separated vertically from the algorithm so neither is hidden. Historical adaptive wording in Theorem 3.4 is restricted here using the authors’ 2020 correction.
